title: The CI credential-lifecycle gate flags any pull_request job that runs Maven or npm lifecycle code over PR content while a package credential is readable; the repaired model-diff pattern passes; today's callers are allow-listed pending remediation #2492

criteria.given: a pull_request job that receives GH_PACKAGES_TOKEN (directly, or as BUILD_TOKEN via a reusable-workflow caller, or as the ephemeral GITHUB_TOKEN of a packages:write job) and executes Maven or npm lifecycle code over PR-controlled files
criteria.then: .github/scripts/test_ci_secret_lifecycle.py flags the job — fixtures cover the saiku#1993 release-token shape and the pre-fix saiku#2305 model-diff shape

criteria.given: the repaired model-diff pattern: Maven runs on the trusted base SHA and ~/.m2/settings.xml is removed before the checkout returns to PR content
criteria.then: the gate passes it, and dependency:build-classpath on the trusted base is not treated as a lifecycle goal

criteria.given: the repository's own pull_request workflows on this build
criteria.then: every gate finding is on the explicit allow-list, each entry links remediation issue #2492, and the list may only shrink (a stale entry, or a finding outside the list, fails the gate)
